title: Microsoft Teams: Raise your hand to speak up at large events with up to 100,000 attendees
description: Ask your questions live and take part in the conversation, even at events with up to 100,000 attendees. In events this size, attendees can now raise their hand in Teams when they have a question. Organizers can then let people with a raised hand turn on their mic and camera to ask their question or speak during the event.
